newsitem.title: POLAND: Poles dig up road in search for hashish.
newsitem.headline: Poles dig up road in search for hashish.

text.p: Police have arrested 12 men for digging up a road in northern Poland in the belief that it contained hashish, PAP news agency reported on Wednesdy.
It reported that police earlier handed 15 tonnes of confiscated hashish to a chemical plant to be incinerated and sold as ash for road construction.

Reports that two workers at the plant had been arrested for keeping some half-burned hashish for sale sparked rumours that more of the drug had survived, and prompted the 12 to dig up a recently-laid road near Szczecin.
